findings.summary: Rooted, traversal, and canonical group escapes are rejected with separator-aware containment.
Relative overrides resolve from the discovered repository root independent of process working directory.
The CreditTransfer PowerShell example uses the environment override or sibling default consistently.

focusedCommand.summary: After review resolution, 4 focused Analysis resolver/index tests and 24 focused Acceptance corpus/documentation tests passed.

finalGate.summary: 12 affected Analysis resolver/index tests passed in 8 seconds and all 29 Acceptance tests passed in 1 minute 31 seconds without rebuild/restore. The override-aware documented CreditTransfer command produced all 18 files byte-identical to the hardened baseline.

notes: The owner approved a fork-only contributor workflow for AhmadKrarha, Abood-essa, and Qhatahet; no collaborator access is required.
FraudManagement and SMSGateway were baselined locally before roadmap decomposition; only project names and non-sensitive acceptance requirements may appear publicly.
The documented CreditTransfer command was executed from the repository root with the checked-in configuration and produced all 18 files byte-identical to the accepted hardened suite.

The final Analysis gate exposed a pre-existing deterministic profile-leakage defect: a referenced net10.0 project borrowed an ancestor root project.assets.json and was labeled net10.0-windows. PF-1 repaired and independently reviewed the generic Program Index contract.
Independent review found and resolved corpus path containment, relative override, and usage-command consistency findings. CT-12 is closed.
